div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Key principles:
- Each region is self-sufficient for reads
- Eviction is per-region, no cross-region RPC
- Cache invalidation is propagated (not eviction)
- Write-through to primary region first
